turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
An item cannot be added directly to an order that has already been placed. The existing order must be cancelled and refunded, then you can place a new order with all the items you need.

Please send the email address used for the order so I can continue with your request.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
If you mean adding or replacing an item, no. Products cannot be changed once the order has shipped. If you want to cancel it, refuse delivery so the parcel is returned and the refund process can begin.

If you mean changing the delivery address or date, a carrier-specific process may apply. Send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number entered at checkout so I can check the available option.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
There is no confirmed fixed refund timeframe for a direct cancellation before shipment, so I can’t promise a specific number of days.

If the order has already shipped, you must refuse delivery. The parcel will return to the warehouse and the refund process will begin once it is returned. The refund is made to the original payment method, but the exact processing time for this cancellation route is not confirmed.
